product_one_liner.value: Luminance provides an enterprise contract-intelligence platform that uses AI to analyze, negotiate, and manage contracts for legal teams and other business functions handling agreements.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes turning contract language into actionable business intelligence across enterprise teams.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer and linked site sections do not provide a pricing page; the site directs prospects to request a demo/contact the company.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified on Luminance's customer-stories page; they are presented as customers, not partners or investors.

employee_band.notes: Luminance's LinkedIn company profile lists 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: The LinkedIn profile lists Cambridge as headquarters; the company location source identifies Cambridge, England, United Kingdom.

founded_year.notes: The company profile lists 2015 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The resource/blog index is predominantly product, company, and marketing content. It includes an AI-model-selection article, but the index does not show two qualifying product-build posts authored by engineers.

public_docs.notes: The public homepage/navigation does not link to a public product documentation site, help center, or developer portal; legal and support contract materials are not a multi-article product docs portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job listing is titled “Machine Learning Research Engineer,” which meets the stated role-title criteria.

model_provider.value: OpenAI and Anthropic (Luminance names GPT 6 Sol, GPT 6.1 Sol, Claude Sonnet 5.5, and Claude Opus 5.5).
model_provider.notes: Luminance's model-selection article publicly names both providers and these models, alongside its proprietary Luna Crescent legal models.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page explicitly says Luminance undergoes SOC 2 Type II examinations and is independently certified to ISO 27001. No other certifications from the specified list are claimed there.

last_funding.notes: Point72's announcement identifies its investment as leading Luminance's $75 million Series C round, announced February 18, 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent identified round was announced in February 2025, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open job-board posting is titled “Account Executive,” a qualifying sales role.

launched_6mo.notes: The November 4, 2026 announcement describes a new evolution of Lumi that lets users find contract insights and turn findings into action, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Luminance announced on September 29, 2026 that Don Riddick joined as Chief Legal Officer, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Luminance identifies Salesforce as a CRM with which its product integrates.
